directives.objective: Remove hard-coded POSIX absolute path (/home/...) (major readiness impact)
directives.remediation: derive the path from configuration or use platform-appropriate directories (e.g. %APPDATA%, %ProgramData%) Recommended path (existing-portable): std::path::PathBuf + directories crate — pure-Rust path handling already portable; only hard-coded literals need replacing.

directives.objective: Remove symlink creation or reliance (`symlink(...)`) (major readiness impact)
directives.remediation: symlinks are a restricted operation on Windows; abstract behind an fs trait Recommended path (existing-portable): std::path::PathBuf + directories crate — pure-Rust path handling already portable; only hard-coded literals need replacing.
validation_plan: Unit test suite passes on both platforms
Output equivalence test: Linux vs Windows behaviour identical on a golden input

directives.objective: Remove unix permission model (`PermissionsExt`) (major readiness impact)
directives.remediation: Windows has no st_mode; map to ACLs or drop the permission step on Windows Recommended path (existing-portable): std::path::PathBuf + directories crate — pure-Rust path handling already portable; only hard-coded literals need replacing.
validation_plan: Unit test suite passes on both platforms
Output equivalence test: Linux vs Windows behaviour identical on a golden input

directives.objective: Remove POSIX signal handling (SIGKILL) (major readiness impact)
directives.remediation: no equivalent on Windows; use TerminateProcess via job objects or process handles Recommended path (existing-portable): graceful-shutdown channel (in-process) — a shutdown broadcast channel removes the OS signal dependency where signalling is internal.
validation_plan: Unit test suite passes on both platforms
Output equivalence test: Linux vs Windows behaviour identical on a golden input
